from rest_framework_simplejwt.serializers import TokenObtainPairSerializer
from rest_framework_simplejwt.views import TokenObtainPairView
from rest_framework.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from .models import StaffDepartmentAssignment

class ClinicStaffTokenSerializer(TokenObtainPairSerializer):
    def validate(self, attrs):
        data = super().validate(attrs)
        requested_dept = self.initial_data.get('department_code')

        if requested_dept and not StaffDepartmentAssignment.objects.filter(staff=self.user, department__code=requested_dept, is_active=True).exists():
            raise PermissionDenied("Staff member is not assigned to the requested clinic department")

        dept_code = requested_dept or self.user.primary_department_code
        refresh = self.get_token(self.user)
        refresh['dept_code'] = dept_code
        refresh.access_token['dept_code'] = dept_code
        data['refresh'] = str(refresh)
        data['access'] = str(refresh.access_token)
        return data

class ClinicStaffLoginView(TokenObtainPairView):
    serializer_class = ClinicStaffTokenSerializer
